annotations.title: Find archived copies of a page

description:
Find Wayback Machine snapshots of a page: the one closest to a date, the first capture, and the latest.

Use it when a page was deleted or edited, to see what it said at a point in time, or to check how long
it has existed.

date.description: Find the snapshot closest to this date: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.
date.title: Date

url.description: URL or domain to look up in the Wayback Machine.
